messages:
Kendra (Security): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: partner onboarding for SOC2/ISO. We committed to a short, machine-friendly partner playbook and an evidence checklist.

Leo (CTO): Agree — let's make the artifact list bind to specific controls so engineers know what to produce. Focus areas: BYOK/KMS, VPC connectivity, audit-log exports, and shared-control attestations.

Ana (Compliance): For SOC2 we need: architecture diagram, control owner mapping, sample access-review records, key rotation evidence, and a signed attestation for any shared controls. For ISO add crypto algorithms and key lifecycle notes.

Tomas (Infra): We can provide daily JSONL log exports to a partner bucket or SFTP. Filename convention: partners/<partner-id>/audit/YYYYMMDD.jsonl. Each record: ts, req_id, principal, action, resource, success, region.

Yumi (Partner Eng): I'll draft a partner README with onboarding steps and a BYOK verification command (one-line test to encrypt/decrypt). ETA: 10 business days.

Kendra (Security): Action items / owners / due dates:
- Yumi: README + quickstart checklist	6; due 2024-10-30
- Tomas: log export spec + manifest (sha256 + retention metadata)	6; due 2024-10-20
- Product/Leo: BYOK acceptance criteria + HSM policy decision	6; due 2024-10-18
- Ana: SOC2/ISO artifact checklist (include sample tickets/transcripts)	6; due 2024-10-22
Please confirm owners and dates. :thumbsup:

Leo (CTO): Confirmed. Recommend we run a pilot with one partner to validate the end-to-end flow. Kendra to coordinate.

reminder-bot: "Partner Evidence Office Hours" created weekly starting 2024-10-09, Wednesdays 11:00-11:30 PT. Calendar invites sent.

Kendra (Security): I'll post the initial playbook draft at go/internal/partner-evidence and tag folks when it's live. Thanks all!
